scope: Current repository status and research-plan audit; eight exact computations and source closure rerun. Not a full independent proof audit.

review.finite_family: Read construction, PBW/CY/central elements, actual 41-dimensional pair family and 17-dimensional graded isomorphism variation. Checked distinction from formal existence; exact slice/center/orbit computations rerun.
review.formal_and_incidence: Read 37-dimensional Poisson component, formal ambient comparison, central incidence, conditional 17-dimensional Artin hull. No counterexample identified in reviewed arguments; no claim of exhaustive independent reproduction.
review.moduli_and_periodicity: Independent readings of intrinsic and categorical reconstruction, finite-window limits, pointed potential functors, period-forgetting and gcd-periodicity. Full global algebraicity and relative periodization remain open.
review.regularity: Read fixed-ambient very-general and finite-order open regularity proofs. Rains Theorem 2.13 and RSVdB Proposition 2.1 including steps (6)-(7) checked against primary texts. This does not establish a smooth proper open in the full mixed family.
review.rigid_ambient: Manuscript has a proof and conditional inputs; related orbit check rerun. Complete independent reconstruction of every rigid-ambient claim was not performed. Do not equate the retained Artin-section audit caveat with a missing proof or a counterexample.
review.residual_strategy: Primary Kuznetsov Theorem 8.9 and JLLZ Theorems 3.11/4.4 checked. Conditional formal product lemma reviewed independently. Actual all-Artin relative residual map is a research target, not a completed theorem.
review.novelty: Targeted primary-source comparison, including rational foliations and rank-two Poisson loci, was completed for the plan. Exhaustive novelty/priority checking remains incomplete.
review.planning: New priorities independently reviewed for conditional claims and feasibility; commutative-limit family clarified.
